_README: School of Engineering first-year program, curriculum code 004, 'common to all four-year engineering programs' - encoded ONCE and linked to each SoE major (Prompt 08 B1).

The catalog prints the program twice (before and starting from Class of 2030); the course lists are identical. The ONLY difference is which majors do not require General Chemistry II (01:160:160), so Chemistry II is its own component (soe-first-year-chem-ii) that a major links only when its curriculum requires it - never an unconditional node here.
The two H/SS electives of the first year live in soe-school (gen-ed), not here, so they are never counted twice.
Semester placement is the catalog's layout, not a binding deadline; it is not encoded as one.
